title: Colts' Josh Downs requests a trade, but Jonathan Taylor hasn't; Who stays? Who goes?
text: The Athletic's James Boyd and 107.5 The Fan's Caleb Zuver react to Indianapolis Colts wide receiver Josh Downs' trade request, and star running back Jonathan Taylor's refusal to take the same approach. Meanwhile, the Colts have lost 11 straight road games against the Jacksonville Jaguars. Is there any chance the Duval County curse ends Sunday? Hosted by Simplecast, an AdsWizz company.
